snippet.title: One Last Hand - Gameplay Trailer | Social Battle Royale Indie Game
snippet.description:
Trust no one. Not even your own cards. 🃏🔥

Welcome to the One Last Hand arena, where poker meets high-energy survival! In this social Battle Royale, it’s not about the luck of the draw. It’s about how well you can cheat the system, manipulate the rules and outlast your friends.
Gather your lobby of up to 6 players, select your avatar and prepare for a tactical showdown where betrayal and strategy go hand in hand. 
Use powerful Relics to bend the rules, sabotage your opponents and be the last one standing at the table.
Are you ready to claim victory?
Wishlist One Last Hand on Steam: 

In this trailer:See how to manipulate your hand with game-breaking Relics. Get a glimpse of the intense Auction Phase where you’ll play your friends as much as your cards.
Experience the fast-paced, high-stakes combat that makes every round a fight for survival.

We revealed this trailer at @indieliveexpo
